title: Komyo-ji — The Autumn Bell
description: A Japanese Buddhist precinct at the evening bell: a three-storey pagoda, an open worship hall with a seated golden Buddha, a suspended bronze bell and a blazing maple beside the raked garden. Broad curved eaves, timber bracket sets, shoji bays and walkable verandas tie the buildings together.

sections.name: Shoji hall and interlocking bracket veranda
